Name: Mega Shed Replacement
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[size=5]Introducing the [u]MEGA[/u] Shed Map Replacement!
[/size][size=4]This mod is perfect for your maximalist Stardew play through or if you are doing a super expanded play through!

This mod replaces both shed maps with the same map so if you don't want to have to upgrade your shed you do not have to.

PIF version is available as well if you don't want to replace your sheds. 

[/size][size=6][b][i][u]Features
[/u][/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]- Allows you to use casks
- Mini fridges are enabled 

There is a room for each type of machine (Fish/Crops/Mining ect.) and a giant storage room for all of your chests.

I also recommend using a buildable kitchen mod and you can have your kitchen in the shed as well!

[/size][size=6][b][i][u]Do not add to an existing save UNLESS all of your sheds are empty or you do not have any yet. Your stuff will vanish otherwise.[/u][/i][/b][/size]

[size=6]If you have any issues please post your smapi log! [/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue where some tiles were impassable when they should have been.
